format: 16:9 only · 1920×1080 (the client asked for the full talk against their slides)

headline: A father tells a drug company, in full, what GRIN disorders do to a family and what CureGRIN is doing about it, cut against his own slides.
story: Lauren Williams asked for Keith's whole presentation as one film for donors, partners and researchers who could not be in the room.

Part 1 is Bryson: the long search for a diagnosis, the fear, the hope, the neurostorms, Carter and the blue glasses. Part 2 is CureGRIN: the founders, the plan to 2030, the census, the 79 percent, the trials.
It ends the way Keith ended: you are my heroes, then thank you.
do: Hook on K1 with THE STAR OF THE SHOW on frame 1.
Title card at 0:07, lower third at 0:12, chapter cards at the start of Part 1 and Part 2.
Put each slide full-frame where Keith points at it (slide map in each row), from the PDF.
Keep the whole talk in order. Cut only restarts, long pauses, coughs and clip joins; cover the joins with a slide or a room shot.
End on K4 then K5, then the end card.
dont: Don't cut it down into highlights. The shorts already do that.
No Q and A (C5225–C5236) unless Keith or Quinn asks on the item.
No full-frame hold on the photos of Bryson in pain (slide 8, neurostorms). Corner box only.
No grey SLIDE cards in any version. No Zoom names readable on the TV.
No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
